title: cistus × nigricans subsp. grosii
intro: Cistus × nigricans subsp. grosii, commonly known as the Spanish or Portuguese rockrose, is a hybrid plant species within the Cistus genus. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cistus × nigricans subsp. grosii are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
